description: Stock units, counts, purchase drafts, lead-time/stock-cover views, accepted-return follow-up and WAC calculations

verification_details.wac_recalculation: Verified Weighted Average Costing (WAC) recalculation per accounting rule D011 upon receiving goods (10 units @ 100 paisa + 10 units @ 160 paisa -> 20 units @ 130 paisa).
verification_details.lead_time_cover: Product stats endpoint computes 30-day daily sales velocity and stock cover days (quantity_on_hand / daily_velocity).
verification_details.returns_handling: Customer return restocks inventory and reduces customer receivable due; supplier return deduces inventory and reduces supplier payable due; excess returns strictly rejected with 400 Bad Request.
